summary: Iteration 3 verified new Trending + Bridal & Groom refinements for KBS Beauty Saloon. Backend pytest suite extended (17/17 pass): confirms GET /api/services returns 178 items with exactly 10 'Bridal & Groom' entries spanning Bridal Makeup / Pre-Bridal Packages / Pre-Groom Packages / Mehendi Services at the exact prices in the spec (₹8383, ₹15090, ₹5216, ₹11385, ₹3000, ₹5000, ₹8000, plus 3 Mehendi tiers). Mixed booking (bridal + regular) POST /api/bookings returns 200 with correct summed total and status=Pending. Manager login/patch/slot-block flows unaffected. Frontend E2E via Playwright: navbar phone now shows '99639 38553' (old '94945 42999' gone). Nav links Menu/Trending/Reviews/About/Bridal/Contact/Manager all render. TrendingSection has all 4 cards (men-haircut, threading, hair-spa, korean-combo); clicking a card scrolls to menu and pre-fills the search input (verified 'Hair Spa'). Menu correctly excludes Bridal Makeup from category grid. MenuSection gender toggles (men/women) both present; women is default; toggling to men reveals 112 add-service buttons across accordion (accordion auto-expanded — good UX). BridalSection: all 4 sub-tabs present, default 'Bridal Makeup' shows 3 packages, switching to 'Pre-Bridal Packages' shows ₹8,383 & ₹15,090 packages, 5-stage stepper clickable and info card updates (verified 'Trial Session' stage). Bridal Consultation WhatsApp button href resolves to https://wa.me/919963938553 with pre-filled text. Adding a bridal package toggles the button to 'Added' and the item flows into the Booking modal (verified 'Bridal Makeup - Classic' visible on Services step).

ui_bugs.issue: Radix a11y warning persists: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add <DialogDescription> (optionally VisuallyHidden) inside DialogContent.

action_items: (Optional/low) Add DialogDescription to BookingModal to silence Radix a11y console warning (carried over from iteration_2).
critical_code_review_comments: services_data.py bridal seed uses correct category='Bridal & Groom' & 4 valid subcategories — matches BridalSection TABS keys exactly.
MenuSection correctly filters out Bridal & Groom by category so packages appear only in dedicated section (no duplication).
TrendingSection integration via onQuickBook -> initialQuery prop works: search prefill verified.
BridalSection 5-stage stepper uses controlled state with animated width; a11y note — buttons are unlabeled beyond visible text (screen readers OK).
kbs.js phoneWa='919963938553' correctly propagates to WhatsApp deep links (verified in bridal consult href).
server.py: bridal booking POST reuses existing schema/logic — no bridal-specific code needed and total is computed server-side (safe).
seed_data_creation: Bookings created via API: TEST_Automation User (regular services) and TEST_Bridal Mix (Bridal Makeup - Signature + Basic Haircut). One TEST_holiday slot-block created and deleted within test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with `pytest -o addopts='' /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py` — the project pytest.ini uses xdist LoadScope which splits classes across workers and breaks class-level state (TestBooking.booking_id -> TestManagerBookings). Frontend selectors: trending-card-{men-haircut|threading|hair-spa|korean-combo}, gender-toggle-{men|women}, menu-search-input, add-service-btn-{id}, bridal-tab-{Bridal Makeup|Pre-Bridal Packages|Pre-Groom Packages|Mehendi Services} (spaces literal), stage-{consultation|planning|pre-bridal|trial|wedding}, bridal-add-{id}, bridal-pkg-{id}, bridal-consult-btn. All 178 services returned by /api/services; 10 of them have category='Bridal & Groom' and are excluded from MenuSection.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All spec items validated: phone change, nav additions, trending 4 cards + quick-book, gender-toggle menu, bridal section with tabs/stepper/WhatsApp consult, mixed booking totals.
